narrative.summary: Revised from 22 (batch 3): the admin-role holder’s own controller is now traced to Sky/MakerDAO’s own verified "SubProxy" contract on Ethereum mainnet - a real, identifiable chain, not an unknown.
narrative.detail: Batch 3 pushed 22/100 with an explicit caveat: the admin-role holder was a real, non-Safe, non-EOA contract whose own controller wasn’t identified. This pass closed that gap: the executor self-administers its own role, and a second role (gating its queue-style action) resolves through an ArbitrumReceiver-pattern contract to Sky’s "SubProxy" on L1 - verified via Etherscan’s own source name. A real, identifiable governance chain scores better than an unknown, even though the local L2 delay is confirmably 0.
